name: Oze Hazuki
source:
The Doting Senpai Next Door

Hazuki is the daughter of the landlord who lives next to Arata. As such, she takes the protagonist under her wing, always looking for ways to support him. With a heart of gold, she's the go-to person for advice and never hesitates to lend a helping hand. Hazuki is also actively involved in the local community. 
Don't let her easygoing demeanor fool you, though—she's got a spine of steel.

"As your neighbor, my door is always open. So feel free to come to me with anything, anytime."

Point: Basking in the tender loving care of a doting senpai
Going home style: Detour. When walking home, Hazuki marches to the beat of her own drum. Embarking on a solo adventure daily, letting her whims guide her path.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/houkago2/character-1.html]Official website[/url]]
